description: This source file implements the LocalVersionHolder class, which manages a local version counter, allows retrieval of the current version, and checks if the local version is outdated compared to a global version.

classes.name: LocalVersionHolder
classes.description: A class that holds and updates a local version number, used to determine if it is outdated based on a global version.

methods.name: LocalVersionHolder()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the local version to -1, indicating an 'old' state.

methods.name: int getVersion()
methods.description: Returns the current local version number.

methods.name: bool isOld(int globalVersion)
methods.description: Checks if the local version is older than the provided global version; if so, updates the local version and returns true.
